# Asset Maintenance Forecast Agent — Production Runbook

> **Scenario**: Asset Maintenance Forecast Agent
> **Platform**: Microsoft Copilot Studio — GitHub Copilot harness
> **Target readers**: Makers, delivery engineers, customer or partner operators

**Estimated effort**: Not yet measured; record actual effort on the Frontier Clock.

**Template:** an example to modify for your requirements; the customer or partner wires it into their environment. See the [Overview](1.Overview.md).

## Prerequisites

| Requirement | Details | Owner |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Build workload | 18 captured build checkpoints; 4 skills; 2 knowledge files; 9 acceptance checks; 4 locked cases. [Inventory](2.Architecture.md#copilot-studio-components), [checks](0.Resources/README.md#template-acceptance-checks), and [cases](4.Sample-prompts.md#demo-prompts). | Template |
| Licensing and capacity | Confirm tenant licensing and Copilot Credits for the GitHub Copilot harness; building, Preview and evaluation consume credits before publication. | Customer or partner |
| Environment and maker access | Record the approved environment, publisher prefix and maker access; use `cli-copilot` authoring and keep the workshop synthetic and Draft. | Customer or partner |
| DLP and data policy | Have the administrator review policies for uploaded asset files, proposed telemetry, maintenance and finance sources, and the intended channel; document blocked paths. | Customer or partner |
| Identity and audience | Review the supplied GroupMembership access policy, Integrated authentication and Always trigger; record who may build, test and use the agent. | Customer or partner |
| Connection ownership | Name owners for the IoT or historian platform, asset management system, finance planning system and Teams. The workshop needs no customer connection. | Customer or partner |
| Test identities | Prepare plant, reliability, finance, planner and denied-access identities for an approved test deployment; do not publish the workshop to share it. | Customer or partner |
| Tooling by build lane | Manual lane: Copilot Studio browser and reviewed files. Easy mode: VS Code Agent mode, the Microsoft Copilot Studio plugin and supported PAC CLI. | Customer or partner |
| Operational decision ownership | Name engineering, asset-owner, finance and dispatcher approvers before replacing synthetic records; the agent never directs field work. | Customer or partner |

## Phase 0 — Qualify and Adapt the Template

### Step 0-1. Qualify the outcome and baseline

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Asset owner

Complete the [qualification checklist](1.Overview.md#qualification-checklist).

**Measure:** How asset condition, service history, predicted risk and budget context are reviewed before maintenance planning. Separate reviews slow planning and raise the chance of premature field action; agree success measures before building.

Fill your baseline record:

| Asset | Measurement period | Condition evidence source | Service history source | Budget context source | Planning decision owner |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |

Agree maintenance replacement connections, governance, support, telemetry and success measures before production.

### Step 0-2. Adapt scope and name owners

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Asset owner

Adapt [scope](1.Overview.md#in-scope--out-of-scope) and the [data contract](2.Architecture.md#data-contract); assign approval roles.

| Role | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| Asset owner | Approve maintenance-planning scope, production seams and success measures; never treat synthetic forecasts or costs as customer results. |
| Engineering reviewer | Confirm screening and forecasts against live telemetry before maintenance or field action; retain safety decisions. |
| Finance reviewer and dispatcher | Approve budget commitments, work orders and crew schedules that the estimate and draft queue only propose. |
| Copilot Studio maker | Build the reviewed instructions, two knowledge files and four skills; remove web search, add no tools and record the owned agent's Draft state. |
| Power Platform administrator | Confirm licensing, capacity, maker access, authenticated audience and data policies before any operational-data connection is approved. |
| Asset data connection owners | Approve historian or IoT, asset management, finance planning and Teams access with dedicated least-privilege references; own connection failures. |
| Acceptance reviewer | Check the four locked cases, the boundary tests and Easy/Manual parity; reject reshoot-required frames and uncited answers. |
| Operations owner | Own production support, session and credit monitoring and configuration recovery; route maintenance decisions to accountable reviewers. |

### Exit criteria

- [ ] Planned maintenance replacement connections, governance, telemetry, support and success measures are agreed.
- [ ] The asset owner records how condition, service history, risk and budget are reviewed today before choosing success measures.

## Phase 1 — Environment, Identity and Access

### Step 1-1. Approve the identity and settings design

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Power Platform administrator

Review and approve the [identity design](2.Architecture.md#identity-and-permissions) and [template settings](../../solutions/asset-maintenance-forecast/copilot-studio/settings.mcs.yml). Apply agent-specific settings when the agent is built in [Phase 2](#phase-2--build-and-prove-the-agent).

Approve document, connector and channel policies; require authentication and verify blocked routes stay blocked.

### Step 1-2. Configure tenant controls

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Power Platform administrator

Approve the environment, audience and connection identities. Define the [authentication plan](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/configuration-end-user-authentication); configure environment [data policies](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/admin-data-loss-prevention).

### Exit criteria

- [ ] The target environment and publisher prefix are approved and recorded before any build starts.
- [ ] The customer approves the authenticated staff audience and least-privilege scopes for asset and budget data.
- [ ] The environment's data policies for knowledge sources, connectors, skills and channels are approved.

## Phase 2 — Build and Prove the Agent

### Step 2-1. Choose the build lane

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Engineering reviewer

| Lane | Suits | Output |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Easy mode with GitHub Copilot (default) | Assisted authoring | Synthetic Draft proof |

[Compare lanes](1.Overview.md#delivery-lanes); local Brainstem remains optional.

### Step 2-2. Build the selected implementation

**Owner:** Template · **Role:** Engineering reviewer

**Easy mode:** use the [authoring skill](../../skills/aibast-easy-mode-copilot/SKILL.md) and [reviewed messages](../../solutions/asset-maintenance-forecast/EASY-MODE-COPILOT-CHAT.md). **Manual:** use the [single inventory](2.Architecture.md#copilot-studio-components) and [tutorial](https://microsoft.github.io/aibast-agents-library/solutions/asset-maintenance-forecast/manual-tutorial.html) with the checklist below. **Portable learning:** follow [deployment.json](../../solutions/asset-maintenance-forecast/deployment.json); it does not replace native Draft validation.

**Manual build checklist** — [captured sequence](../../solutions/asset-maintenance-forecast/screenshots/manual/browserfilm.json). Record current results.

1. Create a blank Copilot Studio agent
2. Name Asset Maintenance Manual
3. Enter the reviewed global instructions
4. Save the instruction policy
5. Remove default web search
6. Add knowledge: asset-maintenance-forecast-rules-and-controls.md
7. Add knowledge: asset-maintenance-forecast-synthetic-records.md
8. Add skill: aibast_asset-health
9. Add skill: aibast_budget-projection
10. Add skill: aibast_maintenance-forecast
11. Add skill: aibast_work-order-plan
12. Review model, skills, knowledge, and safety boundaries
13. Open a fresh Preview conversation
14. Pass ASSET_MAINTENANCE_FORECAST-01: Plant Manager
15. Pass ASSET_MAINTENANCE_FORECAST-02: Reliability Engineer
16. Pass ASSET_MAINTENANCE_FORECAST-03: Finance Business Partner
17. Pass ASSET_MAINTENANCE_FORECAST-04: Maintenance Planner
18. Confirm Draft and stop before publish

**Owner:** Template · **Role:** Acceptance reviewer

Apply the [workshop integrity and recovery rules](2.Architecture.md#state-and-recovery) before replay.

### Step 2-4. Replay the synthetic proof

**Owner:** Template · **Role:** Acceptance reviewer

**Synthetic demo acceptance:** record every locked case: ASSET_MAINTENANCE_FORECAST-01, ASSET_MAINTENANCE_FORECAST-02, ASSET_MAINTENANCE_FORECAST-03, ASSET_MAINTENANCE_FORECAST-04. Use the [acceptance matrix](4.Sample-prompts.md#per-case-acceptance-matrix) and [template acceptance checks](0.Resources/README.md#template-acceptance-checks).

### Exit criteria

- [ ] This lane's Preview evidence identifies the agent, model, inventory and Draft state.
- [ ] If this lane is chosen, the recipe smoke test calls `AssetMaintenanceForecastAgent` and returns its required markers.
- [ ] The manual build has reviewed instructions, two knowledge files, four skills and the confirmed model; web search is removed and no tools exist.
- [ ] Unchanged locked prompts pass in separate fresh Preview chats on the owned Draft.
- [ ] The deterministic validator judges each full final response; an annotated image is only a learner checkpoint.

## Phase 3 — Wire In Your Systems

<a id="shared-integration-controls"></a>

**Shared identity and scope controls**

For each integration, decide end-user versus approved maker/service credentials. [Configure authentication](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/configuration-end-user-authentication) for the [authorized audience](2.Architecture.md#identity-and-permissions).

**Shared scope:** Require sign-in before accessing asset, maintenance or budget information. Request only the scopes necessary for approved read sources. Restrict the operations audience and verify access with authorized and denied identities. Enforce these restrictions at each connection.

### Step 3-1. Integrate Approved IoT platform or historian

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Asset data connection owners

1. **Bind Approved IoT platform or historian — read:** Bind a least-privilege read-only connector or API.

2. **Identity for Approved IoT platform or historian:** Follow the [shared controls](#shared-integration-controls); record the credential choice.

3. **Scope Approved IoT platform or historian:** Apply the [shared restrictions](#shared-integration-controls); document system-specific limits.

4. **Exit test for Approved IoT platform or historian:** Record expected and actual results on approved fixtures. [Boundary case 4](4.Sample-prompts.md#routing-and-boundary-cases): Do not browse or claim live data; answer from the fixed synthetic records. [Recovery](2.Architecture.md#state-and-recovery): Report unavailable evidence; never claim a lookup, work order or approval succeeded.

### Step 3-2. Integrate Enterprise asset management or CMMS

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Asset data connection owners

1. **Bind Enterprise asset management or CMMS — read-write:** Start read-only; gate any work-order write behind authorization, confirmation and audit (preview).

2. **Identity for Enterprise asset management or CMMS:** Follow the [shared controls](#shared-integration-controls); record the credential choice.

3. **Scope Enterprise asset management or CMMS:** Apply the [shared restrictions](#shared-integration-controls); document system-specific limits.

4. **Exit test for Enterprise asset management or CMMS:** Record expected and actual results on approved fixtures. [Boundary case 1](4.Sample-prompts.md#routing-and-boundary-cases): Create and schedule nothing; return the draft approval queue stating that no work order exists. [Recovery](2.Architecture.md#state-and-recovery): Report unavailable evidence; never claim a lookup, work order or approval succeeded.

### Step 3-3. Integrate Finance planning system

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Asset data connection owners

1. **Bind Finance planning system — read:** Bind approved read-only budget actions.

2. **Identity for Finance planning system:** Follow the [shared controls](#shared-integration-controls); record the credential choice.

3. **Scope Finance planning system:** Apply the [shared restrictions](#shared-integration-controls); document system-specific limits.

4. **Exit test for Finance planning system:** Record expected and actual results on approved fixtures. [Boundary case 7](4.Sample-prompts.md#routing-and-boundary-cases): Send no message or approval; Teams collaboration is a future authorized seam. [Recovery](2.Architecture.md#state-and-recovery): Report unavailable evidence; never claim a lookup, work order or approval succeeded.

### Step 3-4. Integrate Microsoft Teams for authorized collaboration

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Asset data connection owners

1. **Bind Microsoft Teams for authorized collaboration — read-write:** Keep review read-only until an approved collaboration workflow is gated (preview).

2. **Identity for Microsoft Teams for authorized collaboration:** Follow the [shared controls](#shared-integration-controls); record the credential choice.

3. **Scope Microsoft Teams for authorized collaboration:** Apply the [shared restrictions](#shared-integration-controls); document system-specific limits.

4. **Exit test for Microsoft Teams for authorized collaboration:** Record expected and actual results on approved fixtures. [Boundary case 7](4.Sample-prompts.md#routing-and-boundary-cases): Send no message or approval; Teams collaboration is a future authorized seam. [Recovery](2.Architecture.md#state-and-recovery): Report unavailable evidence; never claim a lookup, work order or approval succeeded.

### Step 3-5. Connect

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Asset data connection owners

Create read tools first through dedicated references; isolate any write behind authorization, state validation, confirmation and audit logging.

### Exit criteria

- [ ] Least-privilege read connectors replace synthetic data first; any write tool stays separate, confirmed, state-validated and audited.
- [ ] No live lookup, work order or approval is claimed unless an approved tool returns success evidence.

## Phase 4 — Evaluate on Your Data

### Step 4-1. Adapt the evaluation corpus

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Acceptance reviewer

Preserve [locked behaviors](4.Sample-prompts.md#per-case-acceptance-matrix) and [boundary tests](4.Sample-prompts.md#routing-and-boundary-cases) when substituting approved customer fixtures.

### Step 4-2. Set thresholds and evaluate your data

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Acceptance reviewer

Have the business owner approve thresholds. Run [adapted evaluations (preview)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/analytics-agent-evaluation-intro) before publication under approved test user profiles. Keep exact assertions separate from General quality scores.

Run adapted evaluations under an approved authenticated test profile so the agent's tools and connections are fully testable.

### Exit criteria

- [ ] The asset owner sets acceptance thresholds on customer data; synthetic dates, scores and costs are not thresholds.
- [ ] Adapted evaluations record the tested version and user profile; exact assertions stay separate from General quality scoring.

## Phase 5 — Pilot and Rollout

### Step 5-1. Review the template release prerequisites

**Owner:** Template · **Role:** Acceptance reviewer

These synthetic regression gates do not set production thresholds. The reference workshop stays Draft; production approval belongs to the customer pilot.

| Template gate | Required evidence |
| --- | --- |
| Locked asset corpus | All four locked cases return every required marker from their case contract. |
| Manual inventory | Two knowledge files, four skills and the reviewed model; web search removed and no tools. |
| Operational safety boundary | Any created work order, crew schedule, dispatch, safety determination or financial commitment is no-go. |
| Visual checkpoint acceptance | Reuse only frames with a positive expected-state anchor; reshoot-required frames stay withheld from learner pages. |
| Release state | The owned workshop agent is Draft with `published: false`. |

### Step 5-2. Publish and share deliberately

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Asset owner

With business approval, [publish and share](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/authoring-share-agent) the adapted build with a restricted test audience. Keep the reference workshop Draft.

Require explicit confirmation before the production publish operation.

### Step 5-3. Run the governed pilot

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Asset owner

**Pilot entry gate:** Test allowed and denied identities on the published, shared agent; resolve access failures before admitting pilot users. Compare pilot results with the baseline and thresholds; broaden rollout only after go/no-go.

### Exit criteria

- [ ] The production publish operation has explicit human confirmation.
- [ ] The approved operations audience and channels are selected, and the agent is tested in Preview before publication.

## Phase 6 — Operate

### Step 6-1. Retain the operational playbook

**Owner:** Template · **Role:** Operations owner

The template provides the [state-and-recovery playbook](2.Architecture.md#state-and-recovery) and regression cases.

### Step 6-2. Own changes and ongoing verification

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Operations owner

Review content freshness and permissions; re-evaluate source, model, skill or connector changes. [Monitor the deployed agent](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/analytics-overview).

Review maintenance session transcripts, failed turns, tool authentication errors and credit usage in Monitor.

### Step 6-3. Release: ALM

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Copilot Studio maker

Pull before editing, push reviewed changes, then package the workspace with `pac copilot pack` for solution import.

### Step 6-4. Release: recovery

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Power Platform administrator

Confirm backup eligibility for the environment type and rehearse restoration to a supported test target.

### Exit criteria

- [ ] The recovery rehearsal uses a restore path supported for the environment type and target.
- [ ] The operator reviews failed sessions, stale-telemetry answers, connection errors and credit consumption after rollout.
